from collections import deque
def gray_clusters(frame):
    a = frame.ascii.split('\n'); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(a):
        for j,c in enumerate(row):
            if c=='g' and (i,j) not in seen:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); pix=[]
                while q:
                    r,c2=q.popleft(); pix.append((r,c2))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c2+dc
                        if 0<=nr<len(a) and 0<=nc<len(a[nr]) and a[nr][nc]=='g' and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                            seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
                rr=[p[0] for p in pix]; cc=[p[1] for p in pix]
                out.append((min(rr),max(rr),min(cc),max(cc),len(pix)))
    return out

# Select A, confirm its target, then place A at its target
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':18}])
print('after select A, outline:', [cl for cl in gray_clusters(current_frame) if cl[4]<12])
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':30}])  # A's target center (29-32)
print('after place A, green:', end=' ')

    for i,row in enumerate(aa):
        for j,c in enumerate(row):
            if c=='N' and (i,j) not in s:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); s.add((i,j)); pix=[]
                while q:
                    r,c2=q.popleft(); pix.append((r,c2))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c2+dc
                        if 0<=nr<len(aa) and 0<=nc<len(aa[nr]) and aa[nr][nc]=='N' and (nr,nc) not in s:
                            s.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
                rr=[p[0] for p in pix]; cc=[p[1] for p in pix]
                o.append((min(rr),max(rr),min(cc),max(cc)))
    return o
print(greens(current_frame))
print('gray full plus:', [cl for cl in gray_clusters(current_frame) if cl[4]>=12])
